notes: Trend signals are public stand-ins (Wikipedia pageviews, YouTube RSS, Google Trends web data). They are not Insights Finder or Brand Pulse output; in the pilot those products replace them.
Views are YouTube RSS counts (media:statistics). The feed is cached for up to 15 minutes and can lag the watch page.

Since 2026-08-24 YouTube counts a public view from the first frame (TeamYouTube, https://support.google.com/youtube/thread/433409976?hl=en, accessed 2026-09-22). Agentio measured that about 52% of new public views in Fitness are engaged views (https://www.agentio.com/blog/youtube-new-view-count-60-engaged-view-rate, accessed 2026-09-22). Views here are the public count.
Subscriber counts are YouTube's public abbreviated figures (3 significant figures). The number is the abbreviation expanded, not an exact count.
A value marked stale:true could not be refreshed on this run; it is the last good value, captured at lastSuccess.
benchNote: Illustrative bench of 16 real public YouTube channels found through public YouTube search (not through YouTube Creator Partnerships). No channel has any known relationship with Brooks. Rates, fees and turnaround are not public and are not in this file.
